import json,os
p='/root/worktrees/dealroom-sign-edd/docs/edd/briefs/counterparty-c2a-gate3-r28.jsonl'
calls=[]
for line in open(p):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    def walk(x):
        if isinstance(x,dict):
            if x.get('type')=='tool_use' and x.get('name')=='Bash': calls.append(x['input'].get('command',''))
            for v in x.values(): walk(v)
        elif isinstance(x,list):
            for v in x: walk(v)
    walk(o)
print(len(calls))
os.makedirs('/tmp/r29rev',exist_ok=True)
for i,c in enumerate(calls):
    open(f'/tmp/r29rev/call{i:02d}.sh','w').write(c)
    print(i,len(c),repr(c[:200]))
